The season ran from 17 March to 16 December 2001. [[Atlético Petróleos de Luanda|Petro de Luanda]] were the defending champions. The league comprised 14 teams, the bottom three of which were relegated to the 2002 [[Gira Angola]]. [[Atlético Petróleos de Luanda|Petro de Luanda]] were crowned champions, winning their 13th title,{{cite web |url=https://cdn2.portalangop.co.ao/angola/en_us/noticias/desporto/2001/11/50/,766d2c2b-f4a4-46d4-a56b-f828be39b7f5.html |title="Petro de Luanda" team has won the Angolan soccer first division championship |publisher=ANGOP.com |date= 10 Dec 2001 |access-date= 14 Dec 2014}} while [[F.C. Bravos do Maquis|Bravos do Maquis]], [[Estrela Clube Primeiro de Maio|Primeiro de Maio]] and [[Progresso Associação do Sambizanga|Progresso do Sambizanga]], were relegated. [[Flávio Amado]] of [[Atlético Petróleos de Luanda|Petro de Luanda]] finished as the top scorer with 23 goals. ==Changes from the 2000 season== '''Relegated:''' [[Associação Recreativa do Amboim|ARA da Gabela]], [[Sporting Clube Petróleos de Cabinda|Sporting Cabinda]] and [[Sporting Clube Petróleos do Bié|Sporting do Bié]]
